title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
lede: Speaking at a Semafor event, Sam Altman said the AI industry will cope without Jensen Huang running Nvidia, while crediting him with much of the drive behind the boom.

points: Asked whether Huang should return, Altman said he did not know enough to answer.
He drew on his own removal from OpenAI in 2023 and described Huang as a hero with flaws.
Nvidia has agreed to guarantee up to $105 billion for OpenAI's Ohio data center, one of several circular financing deals.
Altman said he is not worried about that money drying up, because Nvidia's guarantees are still widely trusted.
He pointed to fast-growing demand and revenue as the reason the industry will be fine.

sections.text: Much of the compute build-out leans on Nvidia-backed financing; Altman's bet is that demand for AI, not any one CEO, keeps it going.
